g_policy.reason: The banner is opt-in, and the offer copy states the reward (30 minutes without sponsored stories) before the game. Declining changes nothing, and 'if the ad fails' covers both a game that isn't ready and a play that isn't confirmed.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes of feature_time with no sponsored cards, which has no cash value and can't be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an article-open counter reaching 3 on returning to s01, which is an app event and needs no user-written content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: Nothing free is removed, locked or capped. Sponsored cards keep showing as usual unless the reader plays, and 'removes nothing free' is consistent with the model.

g_brand_safety.reason: The banner is a feed card under the pill bar on s01, which is rated safe, and it is app chrome. The ad moment itself has no story content, and the neighboring content is rated safe rather than unsafe or unknown.

c1_revealed_value.reason: As a product_change, the new resource (an ad-free reading window) is tied to the observed core loop f01, reading a story from the feed to an article, and to the observed sponsored cards on s01 and s02.

c2_evidence.reason: The cited elements (s01.e44, s06.e33, s02.e13) support the claims about the feed and in-article Taboola cards, and m01 supports the patchy fill. The 'no paywall, limit, or currency' claim matches the open questions, which only covered the home feed.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: No subscription was observed, and the reward is a 30-minute window capped at 2 per day, so no paid benefit is given away.

c5_moment.reason: The offer appears when the reader returns to the feed after a finished read, not mid-article, and it is a dismissible banner on the feed.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn unit. The reward is granted only once the play is confirmed, and the trigger is an article-open counter the app can detect.

c7_specific.reason: It names this app's Taboola sponsored card below the first story in the home feed (s01/s06), the in-article card on s02, and the feed-to-article loop.

other_concern: Hiding the app's own Taboola or direct sponsored cards may cost more revenue than one game earns, and the model says the feed network varies by session. It is unconfirmed that the app can suppress every network's cards. The s04 'AD' slot is not addressed.
